previous_statement: Choose the universal witnesses C_rect>=1 and e_rect>0 from lem-stage1-rectified-cstar-control and C_bridge<infinity and e_bridge^r>0 from lem-stage1-fixed-unitary-projection-bridge. Unpacking the two dimension-independent O-bounds in the def-delta-projection meaning of the bridge conclusion that P is nontrivial, choose one universal K>=1 such that both rectified nonvanishing estimates are bounded by K(delta_r+epsilon_r). Put B=K(C_bridge+1)C_rect, A=C_rect(C_bridge+4), C_proj=A+6, and e_proj=min(e_rect,e_bridge^r/C_rect,1,1/B). Then C_proj<infinity and e_proj>0 are universal.
new_statement: Choose the universal witnesses C_rect>=1 and e_rect>0 from lem-stage1-rectified-cstar-control and C_bridge<infinity and e_bridge^r>0 from lem-stage1-fixed-unitary-projection-bridge, and put D=max(1,C_bridge). Unpacking the two dimension-independent O-bounds in the def-delta-projection meaning of the bridge conclusion that P is nontrivial, choose one universal K>=1 such that both rectified nonvanishing estimates are bounded by K(D epsilon_r+epsilon_r). Put B=K(D+1)C_rect, A=C_rect(D+4), C_proj=A+6, and e_proj=min(e_rect,e_bridge^r/C_rect,1,1/B). Then C_proj<infinity and e_proj>0 are universal.
